title: January 15 anti-normalization demonstrations
scope: Reported demonstrations; geographic and campaign unit unresolved
participants_original: A number of Bahraini activists; no numerical estimate
threshold_50_evidence: No attendance estimate establishes 50 people at any single assembly.

start_date.summary: Contemporary January 15 report says activists demonstrated that Friday. Retrospective S025 says January 16 after Friday prayers; contemporary January 15 retained provisionally.

location.summary: Bahrain; no village specified in opened text.

demands.summary: Opposition to Bahrain-Israel normalization and presence of Israeli representative; domestic foreign-policy target.

protester_violence.summary: Israeli flag burning reported; no evidence of violence against state. Remains unknown.

state_response.summary: Opened report gives no response; discovery-only denial lead not enough for coding.

scope.summary: S001 shows occurrence report, not organized national action. S002 multi-town claim remains unparsed. No splitting/merging.

title.summary: Title paraphrases contemporaneous appointment/normalization protest report.

organizer.summary: Al-Wefaq shared footage; this does not establish that it organized the assembly. Organizer remains null.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: An unspecified number of activists does not establish at least 50 attendees.

notes: Reported physical assembly opposing Bahrain's normalization policy. Domestic foreign-policy target, rather than an exclusively foreign-government demand. Attendance and locations unresolved. Manama Post denial lead requires opening and corroboration. BCHR table S026 reports three January marches without identifying them; these are not converted into three candidates. Retrospective S025 conflicts on the date. No monthly or village splits made.
open_questions: Can original reporting or date-verified footage establish at least 50 people at one assembly?
